source: 搜神记 第一卷 第二章 谪仙人 / 真相将成形，静压将碎裂
purpose: Seed for EP02 SC42 after EP02 SC41 formal test-mode segment. Continue the ComfyUI short-drama pipeline from the point where truth is nearly taking visible shape and the white-clothed woman's restraint is nearly fracturing into the next threshold: Keshadu's conclusion is almost fully manifest, Shisilang's fury is at the lip of rupture, Tuobaye is nearly completely exhausted, and the white-clothed woman's still pressure is on the edge of visible shattering.
title: 真相将成形，静压将碎裂

continuity_from.approval_mode: Codex auto-pass test mode with user authorization
continuity_from.caveat: SC41 is approved only for pipeline validation. All four SC41 videos used Comfy StillFrameVideoFallback because stable reference-driven I2V is not currently available through Gemini and Runway secret is missing.

source_grounding.anchor_after: 真相将显形，十四郎怒线将断，拓拔野几近空尽，白衣女子的静压已到将崩裂边缘。
source_grounding.adapted_summary: 下一段要把这条线继续推进到真正外显崩裂前的直接门槛。科沙度的判断几乎成形，十四郎的怒势也只差一步就会断裂，拓拔野几乎完全耗空，而白衣女子的静压来到马上要碎裂的边缘。
source_grounding.next_source_hint: 下一段应把隐线从将显形与将崩裂推进到真正外显崩裂前的门槛，为明确出手、揭露或局面失控做直接引爆。
